xsmall.$description: Extra-small control height, 24px at the browser's default text size. Button xs.

small.$description: Small control height, 28px at the default text size. Button sm, chips, menu items, sidebar items.

medium.$description: Default control height, 32px at the default text size. In rem, like the type, so a reader who raises the browser's text size gets taller controls. Button md, inputs, selects, combobox triggers.

large.$description: Large control height, 36px at the default text size. Reserved for hero forms.

compact.$description: Compact table row, 36px at the default text size.

default.$description: Default table row, 40px at the default text size. In rem, like the type it holds.

header.$description: Table header row, 32px at the default text size.

menu.$description: Menu, command and tree rows, 28px at the default text size.

small.$description: Icon inside a small or medium control.

sm.$description: Tailwind's sm, 640px. Pagination shows its Previous/Next words, Stat grids take their columns and a two-month Calendar sits in a row from here.

md.$description: Tailwind's md, 768px. The product folds the top nav's end items into a menu below it.

lg.$description: Tailwind's lg, 1024px. The side nav is inline from here and an overlay below.

aside.$description: 1200px. The aside sits beside Main from here, whatever the side nav's width, while no panel is open; from `lg` it does while the side nav leaves Main its minimum, and otherwise it follows Main.

panel.$description: 1280px. The panel is a full-height column beside the page from here; below, it replaces Main under the top nav.

wide.$description: 1760px. The aside sits beside Main even while a panel is open.

xl.$description: Tailwind's xl, 1280px: the panel breakpoint under its Tailwind name, for Grid's `xl` column count.

3xs.$description: Tailwind's container 3xs, 256px, restated so the `@3xs` variant reads a token. A card header puts its actions beside the title, and an input group shows its shortcut, from here.

2xs.$description: Tailwind's container 2xs, 288px, restated so the `@2xs` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

xs.$description: Tailwind's container xs, 320px, restated so the `@xs` variant reads a token. A KeyValue.Group whose label column is auto puts each label over its value below it.

sm.$description: Tailwind's container sm, 384px, restated so the `@sm` variant reads a token. Pagination shows its Previous and Next words from here.

md.$description: Tailwind's container md, 448px, restated so the `@md` variant reads a token. A field group sets label and control side by side from here. Not the viewport md, 48rem.

lg.$description: Tailwind's container lg, 512px, restated so the `@lg` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

xl.$description: Tailwind's container xl, 576px, restated so the `@xl` variant reads a token. Below it a side-by-side Diff stacks its halves and reads as the inline view.

2xl.$description: Tailwind's container 2xl, 672px, restated so the `@2xl` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

3xl.$description: Tailwind's container 3xl, 768px, restated so the `@3xl` variant reads a token. A WorkPane sets its list beside the detail from here, and the top nav shows its search as a field and keeps its foldable items out of More.

4xl.$description: Tailwind's container 4xl, 896px, restated so the `@4xl` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

5xl.$description: Tailwind's container 5xl, 1024px, restated so the `@5xl` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

6xl.$description: Tailwind's container 6xl, 1152px, restated so the `@6xl` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

7xl.$description: Tailwind's container 7xl, 1280px, restated so the `@7xl` variant reads a token. No part switches here yet.

compact.$description: 400px at the default text size. Below it a region is compact (`@compact:`): a header gives its actions a row of their own under the title. In rem, so it scales with the reader's text size; the Shell.Panel header switches on dimension.query.panelHeader, in px.

split.$description: 800px. From here a body shows two panes side by side; below it an open preview replaces the list, as in RecordBrowser.

shortWindow.$description: A short window: under this height (a phone on its side, a page zoomed to 400%) the banner, the top nav and the panel's header scroll away with the page. A height, so it is no breakpoint: a stylesheet reads it as theme(--query-short-window) in an @media condition, and no class or variant reads it.

panelHeader.$description: Under this width a Shell.Panel's header gives its actions a row of their own under the title. In px, so it does not scale with the reader's text size as dimension.container.compact does; a stylesheet reads it as theme(--query-panel-header) in the panel's @container condition, and no class or variant reads it.

sidenav.$description: The side nav, expanded. The reader may resize it.

banner.$description: The banner area above the top nav, when one is shown.

panel.$description: The panel beside the main area, before the reader resizes it.

list.$description: The list column of a WorkPane.

rail.$description: The rail beside a record page: the Shell's Aside and the Inspector in it. A vertical Attachment, and a Timeline event across at `itemWidth="rail"`, take the same width.

measure.$description: The widest a run of prose grows: statements, notes, descriptions.

tooltip.$description: The widest a Tooltip grows; a narrower window caps it at the room it leaves.

hoverCard.$description: A HoverCard's width, within the room the window leaves.

popover.$description: A Popover's width, within the room the window leaves. The caller's style sets another.

menu.$description: A DropdownMenu's narrowest, unless its trigger is wider; never past the window's edge.

submenu.$description: A DropdownMenu submenu's narrowest; never past the window's edge.

select.$description: A Select's list at its narrowest, unless its trigger is wider: 144px at the default text size.

search.$description: The widest a Toolbar's search field grows while it shares its row with the other controls.

steps.$description: Room for about four steps. A horizontal Stepper or Timeline is at least this wide; in a narrower space its strip scrolls.

skeletonCircle.$description: A circle Skeleton's size, an avatar's or an icon's, unless its width gives another.

skeletonBlock.$description: A block Skeleton's height unless its height gives another.

emptyMeasure.$description: The widest an Empty's title and description grow, so the description wraps at a readable width.

keyValue.$description: In an auto KeyValue.Group a row keeps its label beside the value while the value has this much room, 128px at the default text size, and puts the label over the value below it.

keyValueLabelNarrow.$description: A KeyValue's narrow label column, 88px at the default text size: labelWidth "narrow", for short labels in a card, a glance or a chart's details (Owner, Open). Drawn in rem, so it grows with the reader's text size as the label does.

keyValueLabel.$description: A KeyValue's label column, 104px at the default text size: labelWidth "default", a rail's, and the width without a labelWidth. Drawn in rem, so it grows with the reader's text size as the label does.

keyValueLabelWide.$description: A KeyValue's wide label column, 160px at the default text size: labelWidth "wide", for labels of about twenty characters (Authorizing official), and the most an "auto" column takes before its labels wrap. Drawn in rem, so it grows with the reader's text size as the label does.

codeBlock.$description: The tallest a CodeBlock grows before it scrolls inside itself, unless its maxHeight gives another.

itemId.$description: An Item's id column, unless its idWidth gives another, so the ids of a list line up.

filter.$description: A DataTable column filter's popover width, unless its width gives another.

tableSearch.$description: A DataTable Search field's width, unless its width gives another; it never runs past its row.

previewSheet.$description: A PreviewSheet's width, about half the screen, unless its width gives another.

filterChipValue.$description: The widest a FilterChip's value grows before it truncates; its full text is its title. In ch, so it holds about twenty characters at the chip's text size.

commandList.$description: The tallest a Command's list grows before it scrolls inside itself.

cellCard.$description: The width of the card a table cell opens: Table.List's full list and a DataTable column's glance.

composerSuggestions.$description: The width of a Composer's suggestions list.

composerSuggestionsHeight.$description: The tallest a Composer's suggestions list grows before it scrolls, within the room the window leaves.

tableMenu.$description: A DataTable's Columns and Settings menus at their narrowest.

tableColumnMenu.$description: A DataTable column header's menu at its narrowest.

tableGroupBy.$description: A DataTable's Group by menu at its narrowest.

tablePresets.$description: A DataTable's Presets menu at its narrowest, where its saved questions are a menu rather than a strip.

editableSelect.$description: The width of an EditableSelect's list of choices.

editableCombobox.$description: The width of an EditableSelect's searchable popup, for a long list of choices.

editableComboboxList.$description: The tallest the list in an EditableSelect's searchable popup grows before it scrolls inside itself.

recordSearch.$description: The widest a dialog that searches records grows, a SearchDialog's and a RecordPicker's; a narrower window caps it at the room it leaves.

relatedCard.$description: A Related card's narrowest in the cards layout, which fits as many to a row as the row holds.

recordBrowser.$description: A RecordBrowser's width and its cap: most of the window, for its list beside a preview.

recordBrowserPreview.$description: A RecordBrowser's preview column at its narrowest beside the results, which it shares at 40% of the browser's width.

drawerSmall.$description: A Drawer at width "small", 320px at the default text size: how wide a side drawer grows, and a bottom or top drawer on a window from sm up, centred. A narrower window caps a side drawer at 75% of its width and runs a bottom or top drawer edge to edge.

drawer.$description: A Drawer at width "medium", its default, 384px at the default text size: how wide a side drawer grows, and a bottom or top drawer on a window from sm up, centred. A narrower window caps a side drawer at 75% of its width and runs a bottom or top drawer edge to edge.

drawerLarge.$description: A Drawer at width "large", 760px at the default text size, Sheet's and Dialog's large: how wide a side drawer grows, and a bottom or top drawer on a window from sm up, centred. A narrower window caps a side drawer at 75% of its width and runs a bottom or top drawer edge to edge.

toast.$description: The widest the Toaster's stack grows, 384px at the default text size; a narrower window leaves space.200 on each side.

pageHeaderHeading.$description: A PageHeader's heading measure, about twenty characters of font.heading.page a line: when the row cannot hold it beside the actions, the actions wrap under it.

sectionHeading.$description: A Section header's heading measure, about twenty-five characters of body text a line: when the row cannot hold it beside the actions, the actions take the next row.
